papers.title: Electronic Health Record Evaluation of the Preconception Medical Assessment for Maternal Morbidity
papers.translated_title: 孕前医学评估对孕产妇发病率影响的电子健康记录评价
papers.author: Khan, U.
papers.summary: Importance: Severe maternal morbidity is increasingly driven by chronic conditions present before pregnancy, but existing obstetric comorbidity indices rely on clinician documentation and are not designed for preconception use. Objective: To determine whether conditions represented in a patient-facing preconception assessment are associated with severe maternal morbidity comparably with clinician-derived indices. Design: Retrospective cohort study of deliveries from 1992 to 2025; scores were derived from diagnoses recorded at least 280 days before delivery. Setting: Two deidentified electronic health record databases covering an academic and public health system in San Francisco and 5 other University of California medical centers. Participants: Birthing individuals aged 12 to 55 years at delivery with at least 10 clinical events recorded before conception. Exposures: Preconception Medical Assessment (PreMA) score (range, 0-8) and the Bateman (range, 0-51) and Leonard (range, 0-281) obstetric comorbidity indices, modeled per 1-SD increase. Main Outcomes and Measures: Severe maternal morbidity and nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity within 7 days of delivery, defined by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicators. Results: Among 58,549 deliveries (21,427 in the San Francisco cohort [mean (SD) maternal age, 33.4 (5.7) years]; 37,122 in the statewide cohort [33.1 (5.4) years]), each 1-SD increase in PreMA score was associated with severe maternal morbidity in the San Francisco cohort (relative risk [RR], 1.23; 95% CI, 1.19-1.28), similar to the Bateman (RR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.22-1.29) and Leonard (RR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.23-1.30) indices; statewide findings were consistent. Severe maternal morbidity rose from 6.6% at a score of 0 to 9.0% at 1 to 3 and 17.8% at 4 or greater (statewide, 3.8%, 5.3%, and 14.5%). Associations persisted across racial, ethnic, and neighborhood deprivation subgroups. Cardiovascular conditions (RR, 3.08; 95% CI, 2.50-3.80) and diabetes (RR, 1.83; 95% CI, 1.34-2.48) were most strongly associated with nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study, higher scores on a patient-facing preconception assessment were associated with severe maternal morbidity, comparably with clinician-derived indices. Prospective studies are needed before scores are used clinically.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：严重孕产妇发病率日益受到妊娠前已存在的慢性疾病驱动，但现有的产科合并症指数依赖临床医生的记录，并非为孕前使用而设计。目的：确定患者自评的孕前评估中所包含的疾病是否与严重孕产妇发病率相关，且相关性可与临床医生衍生的指数相媲美。设计：对1992年至2025年的分娩进行回顾性队列研究；评分源自分娩前至少280天记录的诊断。环境：两个去标识化的电子健康记录数据库，涵盖旧金山的一个学术和公共卫生系统以及另外5个加州大学医学中心。参与者：分娩时年龄12至55岁、且在受孕前记录有至少10次临床事件的分娩个体。暴露：孕前医学评估（PreMA）评分（范围0-8）以及Bateman（范围0-51）和Leonard（范围0-281）产科合并症指数，按每增加1个标准差建模。主要结局和指标：分娩后7天内的严重孕产妇发病率和非输血严重孕产妇发病率，由美国疾病控制与预防中心指标定义。结果：在58,549例分娩中（旧金山队列21,427例[母亲年龄均值（标准差）33.4（5.7）岁]；全州队列37,122例[33.1（5.4）岁]），PreMA评分每增加1个标准差与旧金山队列中的严重孕产妇发病率相关（相对危险度[RR]，1.23；95% CI，1.19-1.28），与Bateman（RR，1.26；95% CI，1.22-1.29）和Leonard（RR，1.26；95% CI，1.23-1.30）指数相似；全州范围内的结果一致。严重孕产妇发病率从评分为0时的6.6%上升至1至3分时的9.0%以及4分或以上时的17.8%（全州范围内分别为3.8%、5.3%和14.5%）。这些关联在种族、族裔和社区贫困亚组中持续存在。心血管疾病（RR，3.08；95% CI，2.50-3.80）和糖尿病（RR，1.83；95% CI，1.34-2.48）与非输血严重孕产妇发病率的关联最强。结论与意义：在这项队列研究中，患者自评孕前评估的较高评分与严重孕产妇发病率相关，且与临床医生衍生的指数相当。在评分用于临床之前，需要进行前瞻性研究。

papers.title: Spinal Manipulation and Other Conservative Treatments for Acute and Chronic Low Back Pain Compared With Natural History and Sham: A Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis
papers.translated_title: 脊柱手法及其他保守治疗与自然病程和假治疗对急性和慢性下腰痛的比较：一项贝叶斯网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Menke, J. M.
papers.summary: BackgroundImprovement observed during treatment for low back pain (LBP) may reflect natural recovery, contextual response, and treatment-specific effects. We evaluated spinal manipulative therapy (SMT) and common treatment alternatives within the treatment network and against independently estimated natural history. MethodsWe conducted a Bayesian hierarchical evidence synthesis of 133 retained analytic units, analyzing acute and chronic LBP separately. Natural history was estimated from independent external natural-course/prognosis evidence, with posterior uncertainty propagated into the treatment analysis. The network meta-analysis (NMA) compared all treatment categories within each phase; independently estimated natural history provided an external reference for improvement beyond the expected clinical course. The sham category comprised placebo comparators and interventions known to be therapeutically ineffective. Recovery was defined primarily as pain [≤]2/10, with alternative definitions examined in sensitivity analyses. ResultsIn acute LBP, expected natural recovery was substantial. At 26 weeks, natural-history recovery was 77.3%, compared with 71.1% for SMT. SMT therefore produced -6.2 recoveries per 100 relative to natural history (95% interval -18.6 to +2.6) and +2.7 per 100 relative to sham (-5.7 to +12.5). In chronic LBP, natural-history recovery was 24.1% at 54 weeks. SMT and exercise exceeded natural history by +14.2 (+3.1 to +24.0) and +12.9 (+4.3 to +21.8) recoveries per 100, respectively, and exceeded sham by +12.9 (+2.4 to +22.5) and +11.6 (+3.4 to +20.7) per 100. ConclusionsThe apparent effectiveness of LBP treatment depends strongly on the natural course against which treatment-associated improvement is evaluated. In acute LBP, much of the observed improvement was compatible with expected natural recovery, with little evidence of additional benefit from SMT. In chronic LBP, where expected natural recovery was substantially less favorable, SMT and exercise showed evidence of benefit beyond both natural history and sham.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：腰痛（LBP）治疗过程中观察到的改善可能反映自然恢复、情境性反应以及治疗特异性效应。我们在治疗网络内评估了脊柱手法治疗（SMT）及常见替代治疗，并与独立估计的自然病史进行了比较。方法：我们对133个保留的分析单元进行了贝叶斯分层证据合成，分别分析急性腰痛和慢性腰痛。自然病史从独立的外部自然病程/预后证据中估计，并将后验不确定性传播至治疗分析中。网络荟萃分析（NMA）比较了每个阶段内的所有治疗类别；独立估计的自然病史为超出预期临床病程的改善提供了外部参照。假治疗类别包括安慰剂对照和已知治疗无效的干预措施。恢复主要定义为疼痛[≤]2/10，并在敏感性分析中检验了替代定义。结果：在急性腰痛中，预期自然恢复幅度较大。在第26周，自然病史恢复率为77.3%，而SMT为71.1%。因此，相对于自然病史，SMT每100人产生-6.2例恢复（95%区间-18.6至+2.6），相对于假治疗为+2.7例/100（-5.7至+12.5）。在慢性腰痛中，第54周自然病史恢复率为24.1%。SMT和运动疗法分别超出自然病史+14.2（+3.1至+24.0）和+12.9（+4.3至+21.8）例恢复/100，并分别超出假治疗+12.9（+2.4至+22.5）和+11.6（+3.4至+20.7）例/100。结论：腰痛治疗的表观有效性在很大程度上取决于用于评估治疗相关改善的自然病程参照。在急性腰痛中，大部分观察到的改善与预期自然恢复相符，几乎没有证据表明SMT具有额外获益。在慢性腰痛中，预期自然恢复明显较差，SMT和运动疗法显示出超越自然病史和假治疗的获益证据。

papers.title: Mass Spectrometry-Based Amyloid Typing in FFPE Biopsies: A Five-Year Prospective Experience from a Tertiary Academic Center in Spain
papers.translated_title: 基于质谱的FFPE活检淀粉样蛋白分型：来自西班牙一家三级学术中心的五年前瞻性经验
papers.author: Calamia, V.
papers.summary: Background: Accurate amyloid subtyping is essential for patient management but remains challenging with antibody-based methods. We prospectively evaluated a standardized LC-MS/MS workflow for routine amyloid typing, focusing on diagnostic yield, operational performance, and added value in cases not fully resolved by conventional methods. Methods: From 2020 to 2025, 115 FFPE biopsies from patients with suspected amyloidosis were analyzed at Hospital Universitario A Coruna, Spain, without laser microdissection. Proteins were identified and quantified using PEAKS, with a peak-area cutoff [≥]10 for candidate fibril proteins. Results: Seventy-nine cases (69%) were amyloid-positive, 22 (19%) negative and 14 (12%) indeterminate. AL (51%), ATTR (32%) and AA (10%) predominated, with additional AH (5%), mixed ATTR+AL, hereditary ATTRv and AIns amyloidoses. Binary concordance with conventional techniques ranged from 85.7% to 91.5%. LC-MS/MS provided additional diagnostic information in 64/110 evaluable cases (58.2%), including additional subtyping information in 53/110 (48.2%). The workflow also enabled relative quantification of variant versus wild-type TTR peptides and characterization of SAA post-translational modifications. Mean turnaround time was approximately two weeks and MS findings informed clinical management. Conclusions: LC-MS/MS amyloid typing was clinically feasible in routine FFPE biopsies without laser microdissection and supported identification of common, rare and mixed amyloid types.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：准确的淀粉样蛋白分型对患者管理至关重要，但基于抗体的方法仍具有挑战性。我们前瞻性评估了一套标准化的LC-MS/MS工作流程用于常规淀粉样蛋白分型，重点关注诊断率、运行性能以及在常规方法未能完全解决的病例中的附加价值。方法：2020年至2025年，在西班牙拉科鲁尼亚大学医院对115例疑似淀粉样变性患者的FFPE活检进行了分析，未采用激光显微切割。使用PEAKS对蛋白质进行鉴定和定量，候选纤维蛋白的峰面积截断值为[≥]10。结果：79例（69%）为淀粉样蛋白阳性，22例（19%）为阴性，14例（12%）为不确定。以AL（51%）、ATTR（32%）和AA（10%）为主，另有AH（5%）、混合型ATTR+AL、遗传性ATTRv和AIns淀粉样变性。与常规技术的二元一致性范围为85.7%至91.5%。LC-MS/MS在64/110例可评估病例（58.2%）中提供了额外的诊断信息，包括在53/110例（48.2%）中提供额外的分型信息。该工作流程还实现了变异型与野生型TTR肽段的相对定量以及SAA翻译后修饰的表征。平均周转时间约为两周，MS结果影响了临床管理。结论：LC-MS/MS淀粉样蛋白分型在未采用激光显微切割的常规FFPE活检中具有临床可行性，并支持常见、罕见和混合型淀粉样蛋白类型的鉴定。

papers.title: Additional therapies after minimally invasive treatments in women with OAB
papers.translated_title: 女性OAB微创治疗后的附加疗法
papers.author: Zheng, Y.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo evaluate the rate, timing, and predictors of additional therapy among women with idiopathic overactive bladder (OAB) following initial minimally invasive treatments (MIT). Study DesignRetrospective single center cohort study of women with idiopathic OAB treated between 2012 and 2021. Using ICD and procedural codes, we identified women who underwent posterior tibial nerve stimulation (PTNS), sacral neuromodulation (SNM), or intradetrusor onabotulinumtoxinA (BTX). The primary outcome was receipt of additional OAB treatments,OAB medication initiation or a different MIT. Kaplan-Meier analysis estimated time to additional therapies; Cox proportional hazards and random survival forest models identified predictors. Results1,007 women were included (PTNS: 459; SNM: 192; BTX: 356). At three years, 75% of PTNS patients, 58% of BTX patients, and 40% of SNM women required additional therapies with most patients choosing additional pharmacotherapy rather than crossover to a different MIT. Median time to additional treatments was 10 months (PTNS), 19 months (BTX), and 53 months (SNM). Higher BMI was associated with increased risk of further treatment after SNM (HR 2.1, 95% CI: 1.1-4.2), while recurrent urinary tract infections were associated with needing additional therapies in the BTX cohort (HR 1.8, 95% CI: 1.1-3.2). Random survival forest models resulted in poor model performance. ConclusionsFollowing initial MIT for idiopathic OAB, many women required additional treatment within three years, many choosing pharmacotherapy rather than transition to another MIT. Why This MattersOveractive bladder (OAB) affects over 20% of women in the United States, and current AUA/SUFU guidelines have shifted from traditional stepwise therapy toward shared decision-making and multimodal treatment. While minimally invasive therapies (MIT) are effective options for OAB, real-world data on patient trajectories after MIT initiation, including rates of treatment augmentation, crossover, or return to pharmacotherapy, remain limited. This retrospective cohort of 1,007 women with idiopathic OAB provides novel data on post-MIT care-seeking, with 40-75% of patients requiring additional therapy within three years. SNM demonstrated the longest interval before additional therapy and the lowest rate of subsequent care-seeking. Notably, most women who required additional treatment chose pharmacotherapy rather than crossing over to a different MIT. Modifiable risk factors associated with additional care-seeking included higher BMI after SNM and recurrent urinary tract infections after BTX, though whether addressing these factors would reduce the need for additional therapy remains unclear. These findings reinforce that OAB management is a dynamic, ongoing process rather than a one-time intervention, and that multimodal therapy is often necessary for optimal improvement. Clinicians can use these data to set realistic expectations during counseling, framing additional therapy as a common and anticipated part of the treatment trajectory rather than a treatment failure.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：评估特发性膀胱过度活动症（OAB）女性在接受初始微创治疗（MIT）后接受额外治疗的比例、时机及预测因素。研究设计：回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入2012年至2021年间接受治疗的特发性OAB女性。利用ICD编码和操作编码，我们识别了接受胫后神经刺激（PTNS）、骶神经调节（SNM）或膀胱逼尿肌内注射onabotulinumtoxinA（BTX）的女性。主要结局为接受额外OAB治疗、启动OAB药物治疗或采用不同的MIT。Kaplan-Meier分析估计至额外治疗的时间；Cox比例风险模型和随机生存森林模型识别预测因素。结果：共纳入1,007名女性（PTNS：459；SNM：192；BTX：356）。在三年时，75%的PTNS患者、58%的BTX患者和40%的SNM女性需要额外治疗，大多数患者选择额外药物治疗而非转换至不同的MIT。至额外治疗的中位时间分别为10个月（PTNS）、19个月（BTX）和53个月（SNM）。较高的BMI与SNM后进一步治疗风险增加相关（HR 2.1，95% CI：1.1-4.2），而复发性尿路感染与BTX队列中需要额外治疗相关（HR 1.8，95% CI：1.1-3.2）。随机生存森林模型模型性能较差。结论：在特发性OAB初始MIT后，许多女性在三年内需要额外治疗，许多人选择药物治疗而非转换至另一种MIT。为何重要：膀胱过度活动症（OAB）影响美国超过20%的女性，当前AUA/SUFU指南已从传统的阶梯式治疗转向共享决策和多模式治疗。虽然微创治疗（MIT）是OAB的有效选择，但关于MIT启动后患者轨迹的真实世界数据，包括治疗增强、交叉转换或回归药物治疗的比例，仍然有限。这个包含1,007名特发性OAB女性的回顾性队列提供了关于MIT后寻求治疗的新数据，40-75%的患者在三年内需要额外治疗。SNM显示出至额外治疗的最长间隔和最低的后续寻求治疗率。值得注意的是，大多数需要额外治疗的女性选择药物治疗而非交叉转换至不同的MIT。与额外寻求治疗相关的可改变风险因素包括SNM后较高的BMI和BTX后复发性尿路感染，尽管解决这些因素是否会减少额外治疗的需求仍不清楚。这些发现强调OAB管理是一个动态的、持续的过程而非一次性干预，多模式治疗通常对于最佳改善是必要的。临床医生可以利用这些数据在咨询期间设定现实期望，将额外治疗框定为治疗轨迹中常见且预期的一部分，而非治疗失败。

papers.title: Pallidal Local Field Potentials markers of dystonia aetiology and severity in children
papers.translated_title: 儿童肌张力障碍病因和严重程度的苍白球局部场电位标志物
papers.author: Faiman, I.
papers.summary: Background: Aberrant basal ganglia activity is a key feature of the pathophysiology of dystonia, but evidence is predominantly based on adult cohorts. Neurophysiological signatures during development remain poorly characterised. Local field potentials (LFPs) recorded by bidirectional neurostimulators provide a direct measure of globus pallidus internus (GPi) activity. In a cross-sectional paediatric cohort, we investigated whether pallidal oscillatory, aperiodic and connectivity characteristics are associated with dystonia severity and whether these differ between genetic and acquired dystonias. Methods: We recruited 30 children and young adults (5-20 years) with medically refractory dystonia (genetic n = 10; acquired n = 20) who underwent bilateral GPi Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) implantation. Ten minutes of pallidal LFPs were recorded using Medtronic Percept RC neurostimulators with stimulation off, before DBS activation and, where available, at 12 months. Spectral power, aperiodic exponent and interhemispheric pallidopallidal coherence were quantified across delta (1-4 Hz), theta (4-8 Hz), alpha (8-13 Hz), beta (13-30 Hz), and low-gamma (30-45 Hz) frequency bands. Linear mixed-effects models were implemented to establish whether LFP markers were predictive of dystonia severity, as measured by the Burke-Fahn-Marsden Dystonia Rating Scale (BFMDRS-Movement). Firths Bias-Reduced Logistic Regression assessed whether LFP markers were predictive of dystonia aetiology. Results: Spectral peaks were most consistently detected in the delta, beta, and low-gamma bands. Delta and low-gamma peak power significantly predicted dystonia severity. This association was independent of medication burden, structural GPi involvement, and dystonia aetiology. Theta and alpha peaks were detected less consistently, and their power was not associated with dystonia severity. Pallidopallidal coherence significantly predicted dystonia severity in interaction with medication load in all frequency bands. Low-gamma peak power was significantly lower in acquired than genetic dystonia, but the potentially confounding influence of dystonia severity could not be excluded. The aperiodic exponent was not associated with severity or aetiology. Conclusion: Pallidal LFP markers are associated with dystonia severity in children, with delta peak power, low-gamma peak power and pallidopallidal coherence reflecting clinically relevant features of disease expression. These findings highlight the potential of pallidal LFPs to characterise dystonia across the lifespan and motivate longitudinal studies of their developmental and clinical trajectories.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：基底节活动异常是肌张力障碍病理生理学的关键特征，但证据主要基于成人队列。发育期的神经生理特征仍知之甚少。双向神经刺激器记录到的局部场电位（LFPs）提供了苍白球内侧部（GPi）活动的直接测量。在一项横断面儿童队列中，我们研究了苍白球振荡、非周期性和连接性特征是否与肌张力障碍严重程度相关，以及这些特征在遗传性和获得性肌张力障碍之间是否存在差异。方法：我们招募了30名患有药物难治性肌张力障碍的儿童和年轻成人（5-20岁）（遗传性 n = 10；获得性 n = 20），他们接受了双侧GPi脑深部电刺激（DBS）植入。使用Medtronic Percept RC神经刺激器在刺激关闭状态下、DBS激活前记录10分钟的苍白球LFPs，并在可获得的情况下于12个月时记录。在delta（1-4 Hz）、theta（4-8 Hz）、alpha（8-13 Hz）、beta（13-30 Hz）和低gamma（30-45 Hz）频段量化了频谱功率、非周期指数和半球间苍白球-苍白球相干性。采用线性混合效应模型确定LFP标志物是否能预测肌张力障碍严重程度，以Burke-Fahn-Marsden肌张力障碍评定量表（BFMDRS-运动）测量。Firth偏差校正逻辑回归评估LFP标志物是否能预测肌张力障碍病因。结果：频谱峰值在delta、beta和低gamma频段最一致地被检测到。Delta和低gamma峰值功率显著预测肌张力障碍严重程度。这种关联独立于药物负担、结构性GPi受累和肌张力障碍病因。Theta和alpha峰值检测一致性较低，其功率与肌张力障碍严重程度无关。苍白球-苍白球相干性在所有频段中与药物负荷交互作用显著预测肌张力障碍严重程度。获得性肌张力障碍的低gamma峰值功率显著低于遗传性肌张力障碍，但不能排除肌张力障碍严重程度的潜在混杂影响。非周期指数与严重程度或病因无关。结论：苍白球LFP标志物与儿童肌张力障碍严重程度相关，其中delta峰值功率、低gamma峰值功率和苍白球-苍白球相干性反映了疾病表达的临床相关特征。这些发现凸显了苍白球LFPs在跨生命周期表征肌张力障碍方面的潜力，并推动对其发育和临床轨迹的纵向研究。

papers.title: inClinico Agent for clinical trial endpoint prediction and prospective evaluation
papers.translated_title: inClinico智能体用于临床试验终点预测与前瞻性评估
papers.author: Chen, J.
papers.summary: High attrition rates across clinical drug development impose immense clinical and financial burdens, yet prospectively forecasting whether an individual trial will achieve its primary endpoint remains challenging. Here we present a machine-learning system that predicts clinical trial success across phases I-IV, independently modeling studies with efficacy versus safety/toxicity primary endpoints. To prevent lookahead bias and outcome leakage, models are trained on registration-time features, including target and mechanism-of-action precedent, drug modality and novelty, trial design and operational characteristics, and frozen literature-derived target-choice embeddings. Each prediction yields a continuous Predictive Trial Index (PTI) between 0 and 1 reflecting success probability. On a test set of trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI 0.812-0.845; n = 2,347) and the safety/toxicity model reached 0.809 (95% CI 0.787-0.831; n = 1,485). These models are embedded in inClinico Agent, an agentic AI system integrating frontier large language models (LLMs) with deterministic scoring engines, retrieval tools and specialized clinical skills. We also introduce ClinicoBench, a prospective benchmark of 3,235 ongoing trials evaluated by inClinico Agent and five frontier LLMs, establishing a leakage-free foundation for tracking prospective predictive accuracy as trials reach completion.
papers.translated_summary: 临床试验药物开发中的高流失率带来了巨大的临床和经济负担，然而前瞻性预测单个试验能否达到其主要终点仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习系统，可预测I-IV期临床试验的成功率，并分别对以疗效为主要终点和以安全性/毒性为主要终点的研究进行独立建模。为防止前视偏差和结果泄漏，模型基于注册时特征进行训练，包括靶点和作用机制的先例、药物模态和新颖性、试验设计和操作特征，以及冻结的文献衍生靶点选择嵌入。每个预测产生一个介于0和1之间的连续预测试验指数（PTI），反映成功概率。在2021年或之后启动的试验测试集上，疗效模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）达到0.828（95% CI 0.812-0.845；n = 2,347），安全性/毒性模型达到0.809（95% CI 0.787-0.831；n = 1,485）。这些模型嵌入于inClinico Agent中，这是一个代理式AI系统，整合了前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）与确定性评分引擎、检索工具和专业化临床技能。我们还引入了ClinicoBench，这是一个由inClinico Agent和五个前沿LLMs评估的3,235项正在进行试验的前瞻性基准，为在试验完成时跟踪前瞻性预测准确性建立了无泄漏的基础。

papers.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists (GLP-1RAs) for treatment of tobacco and alcohol dependence: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）用于治疗烟草和酒精依赖：随机对照试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Taylor, G.
papers.summary: Background Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) might reduce tobacco and alcohol use. We synthesised evidence from randomised controlled trials (RCTs) on smoking and alcohol outcomes, including secondary outcomes reported in trials conducted for other clinical purposes. Methods We searched MEDLINE, Embase, PsycINFO, Web of Science, CENTRAL, PubMed, and registries for RCTs comparing GLP-1RAs with placebo from inception to August 18, 2026. Smoking and alcohol outcomes were synthesised using random-effects meta-analyses. We assessed risk of bias (RoB) with RoB-2, and certainty of evidence with the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. Findings Fourteen trials involving 1149 participants were included; 13 contributed to meta-analyses. Across the 14 trials, 8 recruited participants not seeking either tobacco or alcohol treatment. The other 6 recruited treatment-seeking participants: 3 for tobacco and 3 for alcohol. Eight trials reported smoking-related outcomes, 11 reported alcohol outcomes, and 5 reported both. Follow-up ranged from 6 to 60 weeks. All 4 pooled smoking-related estimates favoured GLP-1RAs, although all 95% CIs included no difference and were compatible with increases and decreases in outcomes; e.g., smoking cessation, OR 1.39 (95% CI, 0.77 to 2.53, k=3). Restricting analyses to semaglutide trials indicated a reduction in cigarettes per day (CPD) (SMD=-0.10, 95%CI:-0.16 to -0.04; k=3). Across agents, pooled estimates favoured GLP-1RAs for days without alcohol (SMD=0.35, 95%CI: 0.12 to 0.59, k=3). Pooled estimates of semaglutide-only trials also favoured treatment for alcohol consumption (grams/day; SMD=-0.56, 95%CI:-0.82 to -0.30; k=2), craving (SMD=-0.60, 95%CI:-0.91 to -0.29; k=2), drinks per drinking day (SMD=-0.59, 95%CI:-0.86 to -0.32; k=3), drinks per calendar day (SMD=-0.48, 95%CI:-0.87 to -0.09; k=2) and heavy drinking days (SMD=-0.45, 95%CI:-0.85 to -0.06; k=3), and alcohol-free days (SMD=0.41, 95%CI:0.09 to 0.73; k=2). Two of 41 assessed results were at low RoB, 31 raised some concerns and 8 were at high risk; certainty was moderate for 1 outcome, low for 4 and very low for 8. Interpretation GLP-1RAs may reduce alcohol consumption and CPD, with the clearest evidence for semaglutide. These findings should be contextualised by most evidence being low- to very-low-certainty. Larger trials are needed to establish clinically meaningful benefit and sustained abstinence.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）可能减少烟草和酒精使用。我们综合了随机对照试验（RCT）中关于吸烟和酒精结局的证据，包括为其他临床目的开展的试验中报告的次要结局。方法 我们检索了MEDLINE、Embase、PsycINFO、Web of Science、CENTRAL、PubMed及各注册库，纳入从建库至2026年8月18日比较GLP-1RAs与安慰剂的RCT。吸烟和酒精结局采用随机效应荟萃分析进行综合。我们使用RoB-2评估偏倚风险（RoB），并使用推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法评估证据确定性。结果 共纳入14项试验，涉及1149名参与者；其中13项纳入荟萃分析。在14项试验中，8项招募的参与者未寻求烟草或酒精治疗。其余6项招募了寻求治疗的参与者：3项针对烟草，3项针对酒精。8项试验报告了吸烟相关结局，11项报告了酒精结局，5项同时报告两者。随访时间为6至60周。所有4项吸烟相关合并估计均倾向于GLP-1RAs，尽管所有95%CI均包含无差异，且与结局的升高和降低均相容；例如，戒烟，OR 1.39（95%CI，0.77至2.53，k=3）。将分析限制于司美格鲁肽试验显示每日吸烟支数（CPD）减少（SMD=-0.10，95%CI：-0.16至-0.04；k=3）。跨药物汇总，合并估计在无酒精天数方面倾向于GLP-1RAs（SMD=0.35，95%CI：0.12至0.59，k=3）。仅司美格鲁肽试验的合并估计也倾向于治疗对酒精消耗量（克/天；SMD=-0.56，95%CI：-0.82至-0.30；k=2）、渴求（SMD=-0.60，95%CI：-0.91至-0.29；k=2）、每个饮酒日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.59，95%CI：-0.86至-0.32；k=3）、每个日历日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.48，95%CI：-0.87至-0.09；k=2）和重度饮酒日（SMD=-0.45，95%CI：-0.85至-0.06；k=3）以及无酒精天数（SMD=0.41，95%CI：0.09至0.73；k=2）有益。在41项评估结果中，2项为低偏倚风险，31项存在一些担忧，8项为高风险；1项结局的证据确定性为中等，4项为低，8项为极低。解释 GLP-1RAs可能减少酒精消耗和CPD，其中司美格鲁肽的证据最为明确。由于大多数证据为低至极低确定性，这些发现应结合此背景理解。需要更大规模的试验来确定具有临床意义的获益和持续戒断。

papers.title: Cumulative Prenatal Adversity and Fronto-Limbic White Matter Development Across Adolescence
papers.translated_title: 累积产前逆境与青春期前额-边缘系统白质发育
papers.author: Costello, L. A.
papers.summary: Importance: The prenatal period is a critical window for intergenerational transmission of adversity, yet the neural substrates through which cumulative prenatal stress becomes biologically embedded in offspring brain development remain poorly understood. White matter microstructure is a candidate mechanism linking prenatal adversity to downstream emotional dysregulation. Objective: To examine associations between cumulative adverse prenatal exposure (APE) burden and fronto-limbic white matter fractional anisotropy (FA) at baseline and across adolescent developmental trajectories, and to test whether white matter FA mediates prenatal APE effects on emotional dysregulation. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cohort study using data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, Release 7.0, a diverse longitudinal cohort of US children recruited at ages 9 to 10 years across 21 sites. After diffusion tensor imaging quality control exclusions and retention of one twin or triplet per family, the final cross-sectional analytic sample comprised 10 483 participants. Longitudinal analyses included participants with data at one or more follow-up timepoints across four imaging waves. Exposures: Cumulative APE burden, operationalized as a sum of six binary adverse prenatal exposures (unplanned pregnancy; early alcohol, tobacco, and cannabis use before pregnancy recognition; complicated pregnancy; complicated birth; range, 0-6) following Zhi et al. (2026). Main Outcomes and Measures: Fractional anisotropy in 11 a priori fronto-limbic white matter tracts at baseline (ages approximately 10 years) and across four imaging timepoints (ages approximately 10, 12, 14, and 16 years). Exploratory outcomes included Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) dysregulation profile and Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (ERQ) subscales. Results: Higher prenatal APE burden was associated with lower baseline FA in left uncinate fasciculus (b = -0.00096; 95% CI, -0.00151 to -0.00042; FDR-corrected P = .006), corpus callosum (b = -0.00079; 95% CI, -0.00125 to -0.00032; FDR-corrected P = .006), and right uncinate fasciculus (b = -0.00071; 95% CI, -0.00120 to -0.00021; FDR-corrected P = .019). These associations were robust to adjustment for diffusion image quality, and prenatal burden was not associated with baseline image quality. In repeated-measures models across four imaging timepoints, higher APE burden was associated with steeper FA increases across adolescence (positive APE x Age interaction in 5 of 11 tracts; positive across all 11), though these trajectory effects were attenuated after adjustment for image quality. Post hoc analyses indicated that pregnancy complications and prenatal cannabis exposure were the most consistent contributors to these associations. White matter FA partially mediated the association between prenatal APE burden and involuntary emotional dysregulation, with no association with voluntary emotion regulation strategies. Conclusions and Relevance: Cumulative prenatal APE burden was associated with lower fronto-limbic white matter FA at the start of adolescence, an association that was stable across development and robust to image-quality adjustment. Evidence for altered developmental trajectories was more sensitive to image quality and should be interpreted cautiously. These findings identify fronto-limbic white matter-- particularly the uncinate fasciculus and corpus callosum-- as a candidate neurobiological correlate of cumulative prenatal adversity, while underscoring that this pathway reflects a bounded set of prenatal exposures.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：产前阶段是逆境代际传递的关键窗口，然而累积产前应激通过何种神经基质在子代大脑发育中实现生物学嵌入仍知之甚少。白质微结构是连接产前逆境与下游情绪失调的候选机制。目的：检验累积产前不良暴露（APE）负担与基线及青少年发育轨迹中额-边缘系统白质各向异性分数（FA）之间的关联，并检验白质FA是否中介产前APE对情绪失调的影响。设计、设置与参与者：队列研究，使用青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究7.0版数据，该研究为美国儿童多样性纵向队列，在21个站点于9至10岁招募。经弥散张量成像质量控制排除及每家庭保留一名双胎或三胎之一后，最终横断面分析样本包括10 483名参与者。纵向分析纳入在四个成像波次中一个或多个随访时间点有数据的参与者。暴露：累积APE负担，依据Zhi等（2026）操作化为六项二元产前不良暴露之和（非计划妊娠；确认妊娠前早期饮酒、吸烟和大麻使用；妊娠并发症；分娩并发症；范围0-6）。主要结局与测量：基线（约10岁）及四个成像时间点（约10、12、14和16岁）11条先验额-边缘系统白质纤维束的各向异性分数。探索性结局包括儿童行为量表（CBCL）失调剖面和情绪调节问卷（ERQ）各分量表。结果：较高的产前APE负担与左侧钩束基线FA较低相关（b = -0.00096；95% CI，-0.00151至-0.00042；FDR校正P = .006）、胼胝体（b = -0.00079；95% CI，-0.00125至-0.00032；FDR校正P = .006）及右侧钩束（b = -0.00071；95% CI，-0.00120至-0.00021；FDR校正P = .019）。这些关联对弥散图像质量调整稳健，且产前负担与基线图像质量无关。在四个成像时间点的重复测量模型中，较高APE负担与青春期FA更陡峭的增加相关（11条纤维束中5条存在正向APE×年龄交互作用；全部11条均为正向），尽管这些轨迹效应在图像质量调整后减弱。事后分析表明，妊娠并发症和产前大麻暴露是这些关联最一致的贡献因素。白质FA部分中介产前APE负担与不随意情绪失调之间的关联，而与随意情绪调节策略无关联。结论与意义：累积产前APE负担与青春期开始时额-边缘系统白质FA较低相关，该关联在整个发育过程中稳定且对图像质量调整稳健。发育轨迹改变的证据对图像质量更为敏感，应谨慎解读。这些发现确定额-边缘系统白质——尤其是钩束和胼胝体——为累积产前逆境的候选神经生物学相关因素，同时强调该通路反映的是一组有限的产前暴露。

papers.title: Carbapenem Resistance Among Gram-Negative Bacteria in Bioaerosols at Biomedical Waste Disposal Site in Ahmedabad, India
papers.translated_title: 印度艾哈迈达巴德生物医学废物处置场生物气溶胶中革兰氏阴性菌的碳青霉烯类耐药性
papers.author: BARAI, R. S.
papers.summary: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global public health concern, with Gram-negative carbapenem-resistant bacteria (CRG) classified by WHO as critical priority pathogens. Biomedical waste disposal sites (BMWs) may act as reservoirs for resistant organisms, posing occupational and community risks. This study investigated the phenotypic and genotypic characterization of Gram-negative carbapenem-resistant bacteria in bioaerosols collected from BMW facilities in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Bioaerosols were sampled using active Six-stage Andersen Impactors and passive settled plates. Isolates were identified by MALDI-TOF, followed by antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST). Whole genome sequencing (WGS) was performed for 26 representative isolates, and resistance gene profiling was conducted using CARD and ResFinder databases. Representative isolates belonged to Moraxellaceae, Enterobacteriaceae, and Pseudomonadaceae families. All species showed resistance to linezolid, and approximately 60% were multidrug resistant to carbapenems, cephalosporins, and fluoroquinolones. Genotypic analysis confirmed the prevalence of carbapenemase genes, with blaNDM-1 most frequent, followed by blaNDM-7, blaVIM-2, blaVIM-11, blaOXA-23, and blaOXA-235. This is the first report documenting Acinetobacter baumannii, A. schindleri, A. towneri, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas juntendi in bioaerosols from BMW sites. Biomedical waste environments serve as critical reservoirs of AMR. These findings emphasize the need for surveillance, protective measures, and integration of environmental AMR monitoring into public health policy.
papers.translated_summary: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）是全球公共卫生关注的问题，革兰阴性碳青霉烯耐药细菌（CRG）被世界卫生组织列为关键优先级病原体。生物医学废物处置场所（BMWs）可能成为耐药微生物的储存库，带来职业和社区风险。本研究调查了从印度古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德生物医学废物设施收集的生物气溶胶中革兰阴性碳青霉烯耐药细菌的表型和基因型特征。生物气溶胶采用主动式六级Andersen撞击器和被动沉降平板采样。分离株通过MALDI-TOF鉴定，随后进行抗菌药物敏感性试验（AST）。对26株代表性分离株进行了全基因组测序（WGS），并使用CARD和ResFinder数据库进行耐药基因谱分析。代表性分离株属于莫拉菌科、肠杆菌科和假单胞菌科。所有菌种均对利奈唑胺表现出耐药性，约60%对碳青霉烯类、头孢菌素类和氟喹诺酮类多重耐药。基因型分析证实了碳青霉烯酶基因的流行，其中blaNDM-1最为常见，其次为blaNDM-7、blaVIM-2、blaVIM-11、blaOXA-23和blaOXA-235。这是首次报道在生物医学废物场所的生物气溶胶中检出鲍曼不动杆菌、A. schindleri、A. towneri、肺炎克雷伯菌和Pseudomonas juntendi。生物医学废物环境是AMR的重要储存库。这些发现强调了监测、防护措施以及将环境AMR监测纳入公共卫生政策的必要性。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Writing Across Medical Journals: Heterogeneity in Prevalence and Trends
papers.translated_title: AI辅助写作在医学期刊中的差异：流行率与趋势的异质性
papers.author: Flanders, M. D.
papers.summary: Background: Estimates of generative artificial intelligence (AI) use in the medical literature vary widely, potentially reflecting differences across journals. We estimated changes in the prevalence of AI-generated writing over time using abstracts from 12 general medical journals. Methods: We randomly sampled up to 200 abstracts per journal-year from publications dated January 1, 2020, through August 8, 2026. Abstracts were scored using GPTZero, with journal-specific thresholds calibrated to fix a 1% false-positive rate (FPR) in the pre-AI baseline period (2020-2021). We estimated annual detector-positive proportions and calculated a publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals. Associations with journal impact factor, publication model, and publication volume were examined descriptively. Results: Among 15,268 abstracts, estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased after 2022, with substantial variation in timing and magnitude across journals. In 2026 through August 8, prevalence estimates ranged from 5.7% (95% CI, 2.1%-10.0%) in the New England Journal of Medicine to 83.5% (95% CI, 77.1%-87.5%) in Frontiers in Medicine. The publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals was 66.7% (95% CI, 64.0%-69.2%), and trends were insensitive to specification of false-positive rate in baseline data. The proportion of abstracts showing signs of AI-generated text was lower in journals with higher impact factors and higher in fully open-access journals. Conclusions: Estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased substantially across all sampled medical journals, with marked between-journal differences associated with journal impact factor and publication model. These findings support development of standardized, transparent AI reporting in medical publishing.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：医学文献中生成式人工智能（AI）使用率的估计差异很大，可能反映了不同期刊之间的差异。我们利用12种综合医学期刊的摘要，估计了AI生成写作的流行率随时间的变化。方法：我们从2020年1月1日至2026年8月8日发表的论文中，每个期刊-年份随机抽取最多200篇摘要。使用GPTZero对摘要进行评分，并采用期刊特异性阈值进行校准，以在AI出现前的基线期（2020-2021年）将假阳性率（FPR）固定为1%。我们估计了年度检测器阳性比例，并计算了跨抽样期刊的发表量加权估计值。对与期刊影响因子、出版模式和发表量的关联进行了描述性分析。结果：在15,268篇摘要中，估计的AI生成文本流行率在2022年后上升，各期刊在时间趋势和幅度上存在显著差异。在2026年至8月8日期间，流行率估计值从New England Journal of Medicine的5.7%（95% CI，2.1%-10.0%）到Frontiers in Medicine的83.5%（95% CI，77.1%-87.5%）不等。跨抽样期刊的发表量加权估计值为66.7%（95% CI，64.0%-69.2%），且趋势对基线数据中假阳性率的设定不敏感。在影响因子较高的期刊中，显示AI生成文本迹象的摘要比例较低，而在完全开放获取期刊中较高。结论：在所有抽样医学期刊中，估计的AI生成文本流行率大幅上升，期刊间差异显著，且与期刊影响因子和出版模式相关。这些发现支持在医学出版中制定标准化、透明的AI报告规范。
